checks.name: first publish lands as ONE update
deck.json: unknown keys kept, order applied
no-op republish of the files just read: 0 writes, no update emitted
republish equal by meaning (reordered declarations, uppercase hex, other whitespace, compact JSON): 0 writes
agent republish over a concurrent human restyle: the agent's moved properties land, the human's colour stays
… and the agent wrote only the 2 properties it changed
contrast: the same file diffed against the LIVE doc (no base) clobbers the human's colour
removed element: its id is gone from the model, anchor orphaned
re-added with the same id: the same element (the anchor resolves again)
text: agent's word change + bold merges with the human's concurrent typing in the same box
flow re-order of two siblings: 1 key written
pinned element moved from under to over the flow layer: 1 key written
a structurally invalid file is held (slideHeld with reasons), not trimmed; read returns it verbatim
republishing a valid file clears the hold
a publish with one invalid entry is refused whole; the replica is unchanged
